sources.note: Main homepage. Describes WRS Health as physician-owned cloud-based EHR + PM for 32+ specialties. Highlights AI agents, quick charting, billing, telehealth, patient portal. No customer count disclosed.

ONC certification and costs page. Confirms product name 'WRS Health Web EHR and Practice Management System v7.0', certification date 2021-12-14. Per-provider monthly subscription pricing. Supports 38 CMS quality measures. References EHI export documentation under (b)(10).

Patient portal feature page. Describes secure messaging, lab results viewing, appointment scheduling, prescription refill requests, pre-visit intake forms. Notes providers control what patients see — clinical notes not directly visible.

Scheduling and registration feature page. Customizable schedule templates, multi-provider/location views, automated reminders (phone/email/SMS), self-service check-in, insurance eligibility verification, automated recalls.
Telehealth feature page. Integrated video visits with virtual waiting room, patient check-in/demographics update, online payments, charting during visits. Unique URLs per patient/date.

Medication management page. Surescripts Gold certified e-prescribing, EPCS as add-on, drug-drug/drug-condition/allergy interaction checking, PBM/formulary checks, medication history, Smart Search, mail-order pharmacy support.

Specialty EHR page. Lists 27+ specialties. Six-tier content system with specialty-specific templates for HPI, physical exam, ROS, assessment/plan, procedures. Electronic superbills with specialty ICD/CPT codes.

Internal medicine specialty page. Detailed clinical features: complete IM templates, health maintenance alerts (immunizations, BP, diabetes, cholesterol), bidirectional lab connections (LabCorp, Quest), referral management, multiple chief complaints per encounter.

Large practice solutions page. Multi-specialty support with centralized billing but specialty-specific clinical workflows per provider. Multi-location support. Quick charting, templates, medication management, patient portal, risk mitigation.

Third-party EMR review site. 4/5 stars from 11 reviews. Confirms cloud-based EMR/PM with integrated billing, patient portal, e-prescribing, claim scrubbing and super-bills. Users praise ease of use; some note steep learning curve.

Third-party review site. 46 reviews, 55% excellent rating. Confirms cloud-based EHR+PM, patient portal with secure messaging/prescription routing/PHR, document management, pain management tools. Mentions ONC-ATCB and SLI certifications.

HealthAIDB profile. Founded 2006, HQ Goshen NY. G2 rating 4.5/5 (22 reviews), Capterra 4.5/5 (82 reviews). Named customer: Serenity Behavioral Health. ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR compliance claimed. Subscription pricing with free trial.
Attempted to access Capterra reviews page but received 403 error. Based on search snippets: 82 reviews, high satisfaction ratings, users praise scheduling, fax queue, training options.
Not directly accessed but referenced in search results. Estimated annual revenue $30.7M (2025). Company profile with competitor analysis.
